# Layout Examples

布局组件通常组合使用，先确定容器，再选择 Space/Grid/List 等局部排版组件。

每个组件一节，供 MCP `tigercat_component` 按 `## {Component}` 抽取。绑定差异见 `shared/patterns/common.md`。

## Resizable

Runnable modules: `examples/example/vue3/src/examples/resizable/` and `examples/example/react/src/examples/resizable/`.

Note: `left`/`top` 手柄移动被抓的那条边。`lockAspectRatio` 按手柄选主轴。角手柄不进 Tab。`width`/`height` 传入即受控。

Vue: `<Resizable :default-width="300" :default-height="150"><slot /></Resizable>`

React: `<Resizable defaultWidth={300} defaultHeight={150}>{children}</Resizable>`

Imports: use PascalCase subpaths such as `@expcat/tigercat-vue/Button` and `@expcat/tigercat-react/Button`. Hooks and `notification` use the same subpath rule. Shared types and helpers come from `@expcat/tigercat-core`.
